text.p: PRIMUS Telecommunications Group Inc said Wednesday it has acquired the assets of Cam-Net Communications Network Inc, a Canadian provider of domestic and international long distance services, for about $5 million in cash.

Cam-Net, based in Vancouver, British Columbia, offers phone services to about 15,000 residential consumers and 5,000 businesses in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec. The company filed for protection from creditors in January.
PRIMUS said the acquisition is expected to generate annual revenues of about $9.5 million. PRIMUS posted 1996 pro-forma revenues of $199.3 million.

"We believe this acquisition is an excellent investment for PRIMUS, allowing us to accelerate our growth in Canada with an established customer base and without taking on any of Cam-Net's debt," said Neil Hazard, PRIMUS chief financial officer.
PRIMUS is a multinational telecommunications company offering domestic and international long-distance switched voice, data, private network and value-added services.
